description_en: This API is used to obtain channel distribution statistics
description_zh: 本接口用于获取频道分布统计数据
kebab_example: aliyun rtc describe-channel-distribution-stat-data --app-id testappid --channel-id testid --created-ts 1614936817 --stat-dim OS --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeChannelDistributionStatData

parameters.help_en: The UNIX timestamp indicating when the channel was created. Data from the last 30 days can be queried. The value is expressed as a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 创建频道的时间戳，支持查询最近30天的数据。使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒
parameters.name: created_ts

parameters.help_en:
Channel release time, represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. If this parameter is empty, the current time is used.
If the provided channel release time exceeds the actual release time, data from the creation time to the actual release time will be returned
parameters.help_zh:
频道释放时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。参数为空表示获取当前时间。
如果传入的频道释放时间超过真实的释放时间，将返回从创建时间开始到真实释放时间之间的数据
parameters.name: destroyed_ts

parameters.help_en:
Statistical dimension. Valid values:
OS: Statistics by operating system.
SDK_VERSION: Statistics by SDK version
parameters.help_zh:
统计维度。取值：
OS：按照系统统计。
SDK_VERSION：按照SDK版本统计
parameters.name: stat_dim

CallUserCount.description_en: Number of users involved in communication

CallUserRatio.description_en: Ratio of users involved in communication, represented as a decimal. For example, 1.0000 indicates 100%
CallUserRatio.description_zh: 通信人数占比，用小数表示，例如1.0000表示通信人数占比为100%
CallUserRatio.title_en: 通信人数占比，用小数表示，例如1.0000表示通信人数占比为100%。
CallUserRatio.title_zh: 通信人数占比，用小数表示，例如1.0000表示通信人数占比为100%。
